answer: Reputation Decay Auction. Each new identity must buy a decaying “relic” credential at auction; price rises geometrically with the count of unproven identities created in the same epoch, then decays toward a floor. To sustain N sybils an attacker pays the summed escalating prices, so cost scales superlinearly with fleet size. Honest agents amortize via a slow “nebula” score earned from settled work, and a “knoll” threshold caps how many unproven identities a single funding source can back.
